initialization_order: W1, then W2, then W3, using splitmix64-v1 normal draws. Biases stay zero and do not draw. The stream then samples replay.
tie_break: lowest action index, which follows manifest destination order
training_updates: train_step and train_from_replay only; choose does not update weights or consume the seed stream
feature_order: for each destination in order: cpu_queue_length, channel_queue_length, cpu_remaining_busy_normalized, channel_remaining_busy_normalized, projected_completion_normalized, projected_task_energy_normalized
note: P8b provisional network. No episode training and no held-out inference. The seed, learning rate, and architecture are recorded, not frozen.
